newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Theragenics started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Theragenics started as buy.

text.p: --Dain Bosworth Inc said Wednesday it initiated coverage of Theragenics Corp with a buy rating and a 12-month price target of $28-$32.
--Dain's earnings per share estimates on the company are $0.31 for 1997, $0.55 for 1998 and $1.17 for 1999.

--"Theragenics has established a core competence in manufacturing the radioactive substance, palladium-103 and producing the small ThereaSeed devices" for treating early-stage cases of prostate cancer, Dain said in a report.
